name: Nadiral-Armillary
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around an exposed planetary core, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
Standing still, you feel the scorching air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Surveyors date the monolithic structures of unknown origin to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
